author: Ari Koslow
title: Shane Bieber (elbow) to throw bullpen Saturday
desc: Shane Bieber is scheduled to throw a bullpen on Saturday.
impact: Bieber re-joined the Blue Jays on Thursday. If all goes well with his bullpen, his next start should come back with Toronto.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ronel Blanco (elbow) sent on rehab assignment
desc: The Astros sent RHP Ronel Blanco on a rehab assignment to Rookie League-FCL.
impact: Blanco underwent an internal brace procedure last June. He will figure to require a lengthy rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyrone Taylor (hip) sent on rehab assignment
desc: The Mets sent OF Tyrone Taylor on a rehab assignment to Double-A Binghamton.
impact: Taylor has been on the injured list since May 26. He could be activated by the end of June.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Justin Dean recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Cubs recalled OF Justin Dean from Triple-A Iowa.
impact: Dean is slashing .238/.369/.354 with three home runs and 14 steals in Triple-A this season. He'll add depth in the outfield for the Cubs.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Bloss (elbow) throws 65 pitches in rehab start Thursday
desc: Jake Bloss threw 65 pitches over four innings for Triple-A Buffalo on Thursday.
impact: Bloss allowed two runs on one hit with three strikeouts and two walks. It was his first rehab start in Triple-A and fifth rehab start overall.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Evan Phillips (elbow) makes rehab appearance Thursday
desc: Evan Phillips threw a scoreless inning for Triple-A Oklahoma City on Thursday.
impact: Phillips worked around a hit and walk with a strikeout. He appears to be nearing his return to the Dodgers bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Clay Holmes (fibula) to begin throwing by July 1
desc: Clay Holmes is reportedly progressing well and plans to begin throwing by July 1.
impact: Holmes fractured his fibula on May 15th. He is on track to return by the start of August.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Austin Wells (headaches) hits two home runs in rehab game Thursday
desc: Austin Wells went deep twice in a rehab game for Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre on Thursday.
impact: Wells caught all nine innings. He should be activated close to when he is first available to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Eury Perez (leg) throws 51 pitches in rehab start Thursday
desc: Eury Perez threw 51 pitches over 3 2/3 innings on Thursday in a rehab start for Triple-A Jacksonville.
impact: Perez recorded five strikeouts and allowed one run in his first rehab outing. He'll likely need at least a couple more rehab starts before he is activated.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Colson Montgomery goes yard in win over Yankees
desc: Colson Montgomery went 2-for-3 in a win over the Yankees with a solo home run and one walk.
impact: Montgomery has flashed his power stroke of late, homering in three of his last four contests. The infielder offers manager Will Venable another explosive bat as part of a streaky White Sox lineup, posting an .841 OPS with 20 home runs, 45 RBI, 36 runs scored, and one stolen base through 70 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Andrew Benintendi blasts grand slam in win over Yankees
desc: Andrew Benintendi went 1-for-1 in a 5-1 win over the Yankees with a grand slam.
impact: Benintendi has heated up at the plate, driving in runs in four of his last six contests. The veteran remains one of many streaky options in the White Sox lineup to this point, slashing .242 with nine home runs, 37 RBI, 30 runs scored, and one stolen base across 66 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Sean Burke cruises on mound in win over Yankees
desc: Sean Burke allowed one earned run on five hits and one walk while striking out eight over 7 1/3 innings in Thursday's win over the Yankees.
impact: Burke continues a solid stretch on the mound of late, allowing two earned runs or less in four of his last six trips to the mound. The right-hander has offered manager Will Venable one of the more stable options every fifth day, carrying a 3.89 ERA and 1.22 WHIP with a 4-4 record and 9.0 K/9 ratio through 15 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Ryan McMahon homers in loss to White Sox
desc: Ryan McMahon went 1-for-3 in Thursday's loss to the White Sox with a solo home run.
impact: McMahon has offered mixed results at the plate of late, picking up hits in six of his last 13 contests. The infielder remains one of the more underwhelming options in the Yankees lineup for manager Aaron Boone, hitting .211 with eight home runs, 23 RBI, 19 runs scored, and three stolen bases across 67 games.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Juan Soto launches pair of homers
desc: Juan Soto went 2-for-4 with two solo home runs and a walk in Thursday's 6-4 win over the Phillies. He opened the scoring with a first-inning homer off Aaron Nola before taking Nola deep again in his next plate appearance. It was Soto's second multi-homer game of the season.
impact: Soto is 14-for-29 with three home runs over his last eight games. He is slashing .300/.398/.582 with 17 home runs, seven doubles, one triple, 38 RBI, 36 runs, and six stolen bases across 249 plate appearances this season.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Devin Williams records 11th save
desc: Devin Williams earned the save Thursday against the Phillies, allowing one run on two hits and one walk while striking out one over one inning. He entered with a three-run lead in the ninth and allowed a run on a Justin Crawford RBI single before preventing further damage.
impact: Williams secured his 11th save of the season and has recorded scoreless outings in 16 of his last 18 appearances. He owns a 5.18 ERA, 1.56 WHIP, and 38:15 K:BB across 24.1 innings.
